Minimalist. Purple gradient buttons. A hero section that says "The future of [blank] is here." You know what I'm talking about.

events.title: Cafe Cursor San Francisco: Startup Edition
events.description:
Founders and startup builders (engineers, designers, PMs): join us at Cafe Cursor.
We're taking over a cafe in North Beach and inviting Cursor users to swing by.
Bring your laptop with you and spend some time building with other Cursor users and meet the Cursor team. We'll have some Cursor credits and coffee waiting for you. You can also just pop by for coffee and to say hi!
A bunch of engineers from the Cursor team will be around throughout the day at the cafe. Welcome to ask any questions and share what you're building.
We have two slots available for co-working. When you sign up, please choose whichever works best for you. We have limited space and will do our best to accommodate.
10am - 2pm - grab a table and co-work for a few hours
